import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-v', 'crucible_hidden'], capture_output=True, text=True)
# Count passed
passed = [l for l in result.stdout.split('\n') if 'PASSED' in l]
failed = [l for l in result.stdout.split('\n') if 'FAILED' in l]
print(f"Passed: {len(passed)}")
print(f"Failed: {len(failed)}")
for p in passed:
    print(f"  PASS: {p.strip()}")
